title: India's GST collections just posted their fastest growth of the fiscal year
sources: News on Air - India's gross GST collections rise 23% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October
Angel One / IBEF - India's net GST collections surge 25.6% to Rs 2.03 trillion in October 2026
caption:
India's GST collections just posted their fastest growth of the fiscal year. 25.6% higher than last October.

India's net GST collections rose 25.6% year-on-year to Rs 2.03 lakh crore in October 2026 - the fastest net growth of FY27 so far. Gross collections rose about 23% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore, with import-linked GST up 42.2% and domestic GST up a steadier 15.8%. April-October cumulative gross collections reached Rs 14.78 lakh crore, up 13.2% year-on-year.

A tax collection number sounds dry. But this one is a real-time read on the economy, not a forecast.

Sources: News on Air, Angel One/IBEF, citing government data (2026)
